name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 2px solid #005FCC focus ring with a 3px outer glow to every interactive element. This makes the focus state unmistakable for keyboard users, especially on high-contrast backgrounds, without relying on color alone. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings that may feel bold, but clarity beats subtlety when accessibility is the goal.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring with 3px glow shrinks already-tight touch targets on mobile—users miss buttons because the glow overlaps adjacent elements. A 1px ring with 2px glow meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on most backgrounds and preserves tap space. Test with Playwright MCP’s keyboard and touch emulation to confirm both focus visibility and tap accuracy.
